'''Amos Granley''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rhamalai]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] arrived on Rhamalai, they rounded up and forcibly conscripted young men into the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]], including Granley, his friend [[Dorn Lister]], and his neighbor [[Denel Moonrunner]].
